How to use these

  1. Pick your subject, read the Marks lens on each chapter first — it tells you what is worth studying hard.
  2. Work the Deep concepts, then close the page and attempt that chapter’s questions.
  3. Tick Mark complete at the bottom of each chapter; the hub tracks you on this device.
  4. Finish with Quick revision and a timed sample paper.
